children: Reliance Industries (RIL) is set to announce its September-quarter earnings on October 30, 2026, with the Street closely watching performance across its oil-to-chemicals (O2C), retail and digital services businesses. Margin trends, subscriber growth at Jio, retail demand and management commentary on the outlook will be among the key focus areas.
When will Reliance Industries announce its Q2 results?

Reliance Industries has scheduled a board meeting on Friday, October 30, to consider and approve its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.

The company disclosed the earnings date in a stock exchange filing on Tuesday. While Reliance has not specified the exact timing of the results announcement, it will hold an analyst call after the board meeting to discuss quarterly performance and provide business updates.

Reliance Industries reported a consolidated net profit of ₹20,946 crore for the first quarter of FY27, compared with ₹16,971 crore in the previous quarter. Its net profit stood at ₹26,994 crore in the year-ago quarter, which included a one-time gain of ₹8,924 crore related to the sale of its stake in Asian Paints.

The company's consolidated revenue increased to ₹3.09 lakh crore in Q1 FY27 from ₹2.94 lakh crore in Q4 FY26. Revenue stood at ₹2.44 lakh crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

Consolidated earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose to ₹47,517 crore in Q1 FY27, compared with ₹44,141 crore in the previous quarter and ₹42,905 crore a year earlier.
The consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 15.4% in Q1 FY27, compared with 15% in Q4 FY26 and 17.6% in Q1 FY26.
Investors will look for updates on revenue growth, profitability and performance across the company's key businesses when Reliance Industries announces its Q2 FY27 results.
Reliance Industries share price on October 27

Reliance Industries shares closed at ₹1,196.20 on the NSE on Tuesday, October 27, down ₹5.60, or 0.47%, from the previous close. The stock opened at ₹1,195. The company's 52-week high on the NSE stands at ₹1,611.80, while its 52-week low is ₹1,152.20.
